theorems.name: Submission.bf_starProjection_isometricChart
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∃ f : Rn (n + ℓ) → Rn n, LipschitzWith 1 f ∧ (∀ a b : Rn (n + ℓ), f a = f b ↔ W.starProjection a = W.starProjection b) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), μHE[n] (W.starProjection '' S) = volume (f '' S)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
